NSH.head: A steep climb for the Predators
NSH.body: Even though Nashville has home-ice advantage, Colorado has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately. On top of that, Nashville is on the second night of a back-to-back. To pull this off, the Predators can start with a penalty kill that holds up, plus Justus Annunen stealing the show.
